description: Model-assisted visual audit; not a human audit and not ground truth.

decision_order: If no candidate satisfies the full caption: no_match.
If exactly one candidate satisfies every stated element: unique.
If multiple candidates satisfy it because they are genuine near-duplicates despite a specific caption: multiple_plausible.
If multiple candidates satisfy it because the caption lacks discriminating information and would match many corpus images: underspecified.
If the evidence cannot resolve the decision without guessing: unsure.
ambiguity_audit.blinding: Only query_caption and candidate_A through candidate_F may be inspected. audit_key.csv must not be joined or opened during labelling.

decision_order: If any retrieved image satisfies the caption as fully as the positive: retrieved_also_correct.
Otherwise, if the caption would match many images generally: caption_underspecified.
Otherwise, if the positive is itself a poor match: positive_atypical.
Otherwise, if retrieved images match the scene or subject but miss one discriminating detail: fine_grained_miss.
Otherwise: label_defensible. Use unsure only when visual evidence is insufficient and add a note.
